import sys

def main():
    input1 = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    n = int(input1[0])
    b = int(input1[1])
    
    input2 = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    positions = [0] * n
    parity = [0] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        positions[i] = int(input2[i])
        parity[i] = -1 if positions[i] % 2 == 0 else 1
    
    fees = []
    balance = 0
    
    for i in range(n - 1):
        balance += parity[i]
        if balance == 0:
            gap = positions[i + 1] - positions[i]
            fees.append(-gap if gap < 0 else gap)
    
    fees.sort()
    
    spent = 0
    selected = 0
    
    for fee in fees:
        if spent + fee <= b:
            spent += fee
            selected += 1
    
    print(selected)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
